protocol_deviations: No EffectClass enum value was added: REVERSIBLE_WRITE already exists and is the closest class for a durable-but-overwritable KB write, so the issue's fallback ('map to the closest existing effect class and note the deviation') applies trivially — there was nothing to add and no exhaustive test to break.
A DONE predicate over a KB.* ref is rejected at parse time by the pre-existing target-ownership rule rather than at validate_program; KB facts are observed by recalling them into a state node first.
The sealed program.think uses only pre-existing commands per protocol; remember/recall are exercised by the unsealed scratch-remember-recall.think and by the live two-run CLI demo instead.
Issue #15 ran concurrently on parser.py, coordinator.py and shared test files; all edits here were kept small, additive and in separate regions, and the combined suite is green.
